_purpose: Token reduction for agent runs. Compression exists to make code generation and command output cheap. It never applies to documentation.
_documentation_rule: Every Markdown file in this repository is read by a reviewer and later presented to a chief technology officer and a chief executive. Compressed prose in a document is a defect. The exclusions below are one of five independent guards; see docs/04-operations.md for the others, and tools/prose_guard.py for the one that fails the build.

proxy._reason: Routing provider traffic through a local proxy adds a failure mode with no recovery path in the middle of a timed session. The skill and the shrink command are used on their own.

pixel._reason: Rendering dense text to images is an unnecessary variable during a recorded session.

_shrink_rule: The shrink command wraps a COMMAND so that its output is smaller on the way into an agent's context. It is never applied to file contents, and never to anything a human reads. scripts/lint.sh enforces this on the scripts themselves.
_disable: Set CAVEMAN_DISABLE=1 to remove compression from every script with no other behavioural change. The scaffold does not depend on this tool.
